beginner_intro: Al-Qadr ("The Power") is a Meccan surah of 5 ayahs. Arabic text: Al-Quran Hafazan System (Uthmani Hafs script). Translation: Pickthall (public domain).

ayahs.arabic_text: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

translations.text: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!

ayahs.arabic_text: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ

translations.text: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.arabic_text: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

translations.text: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
